name: Gemini 2.0 Flash is shut down; move to gemini-3.6-flash
gain: Google's release notes for 1 Jun 2026 say these models are now shut down, so a request to one no longer works.
how: Change gemini-2.0-flash and gemini-2.0-flash-001 to gemini-3.6-flash, and gemini-2.0-flash-lite and gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001 to gemini-3.1-flash-lite.
trade_offs: gemini-3.1-flash-lite has its own earliest shutdown date of 7 May 2027.
gemini-3.6-flash doubles in price on 1 Jan 2027, from $0.75 to $1.50 per 1M input tokens.
needs: Nothing new; the same Gemini key.
